label: 1x64 PLC splitter, SC/APC, pre-connectorised
description: 1x64 balanced planar-lightwave-circuit splitter with SC/APC connectors on the input and all sixty-four output legs, 1260-1600 nm. Insertion loss <=21.0 dB (pre-connectorised), uniformity <=1.8 dB, PDL <=0.40 dB, return loss >=55 dB. The largest split a GPON ODN normally carries, and the one that eats most of the class B+ budget.
notes: Prysmian AC005 issue 06, pre-connectorised table: 1x64 insertion loss <=21.0 dB, uniformity <=1.8, PDL <=0.40, RL >=55 dB, 1260-1600 nm, 12 x 4 x 58 mm package. XSPSG00054 is the SC/APC variant; unconnectorised is XSPSG00044 at <=20.4 dB. This part's 21.0 dB is exactly the simulator's worst-case figure for a 1:64, so the modelled budget matches the datasheet rather than flattering it.
